ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white regions located on the distal portions of both lobes. Significant low-intensity black clustering observed at the proximal base near the median notch, extending outward along the lower interior edges. Dense, low-intensity linear streaks and focal points are interspersed within the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio within the central bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels relative to the mean edge line; peaks are more pronounced and jagged on the outer lateral margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve tapering into sharp, slightly upward-curled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white and grey pixel patterns detected at the extreme distal tips of both flukes, indicating localized surface texture variation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of parallel, dark-tone linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark-brown irregular appendage or foreign object is visible attached to the trailing edge of the left fluke tip. Visible notch-like loss of tissue on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense concentration of thin, vertical linear streaks on the right lobe forming a distinct repetitive pattern across the high-intensity background.
